1.title: Why Can't Anyone Answer Questions About the Business? — Garrett Galow, WorkOS
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: WorkOS built an agent-based internal tool (Studio) that lets non-technical teams query databases through natural language, using LangGraph + Opus + a guidance layer to enforce schema context and join logic, dramatically cutting the request-answer-clarify cycle.

2.title: The agent-ready web: Simplify user actions with WebMCP — Tara Agyemang, Google
2.author: AI Engineer
2.hook: WebMCP gives AI agents a structured "menu" of tools (instead of parsing DOM/screenshots/clicks), reducing token spend and brittleness—but only worth implementing after semantic HTML, accessibility, and performance foundations are solid.
